initiatives.name: Food Not Bombs San Luis Obispo
initiatives.description: FNB is an all-volunteer movement that recovers food that would otherwise be discarded & shares free meals with the hungry.

initiatives.name: SLO Bangers
initiatives.description: Syringe exchange and overdose prevention program in San Luis Obispo County, with weekly sites in San Luis Obispo, Morro Bay, Paso Robles and Atascadero offering syringes, naloxone and HIV/Hep C testing.
